timeline.text: A search engine opened my news page and saw an empty shell. No headline, no words — just a blank spinner.
Every article loaded after the page already arrived — like handing a librarian a sealed box.
So now Next.js bakes those articles straight into the page on the server, before it reaches a browser.
The first twelve articles now render before the page ever leaves the server.
No more empty shell — crawlers and readers now see the same twelve.
